answers.reason: The dean only participates in their single designated place, the faculty council, and not in central university bodies.
The dean participates only in the faculty council and does not sit in bodies dealing with other questions like central budget allocation.
Every member has only one place where they take part, which for the dean is the faculty council, not the appointment committee.
The description explicitly states that the dean leads one faculty and chairs its council.
